description: React component file defining calendar event cells, including EmptyCell, AvailableCellsForDay, Cell, and CustomCell, used in weekly calendar views with out-of-office and availability features.

methods.name: EmptyCell
methods.description: Renders an empty calendar cell with calculated top offset based on date and time.

methods.name: AvailableCellsForDay
methods.description: Displays available time slots for a specific day, including out-of-office slots, with memoized calculations.

methods.name: Cell
methods.description: Represents a single calendar cell, handling click events and hover effects.

methods.name: CustomCell
methods.description: Wraps a calendar cell with custom styling and optional children.
